sentences.text: Using the loan amount of ₹25,00,000, the 8.5% p.a. rate, and the 240-month tenor, the total interest payable over the full tenor is {{calc:1}}.
The only stated total-interest figure in the record is the illustrative ₹3,274 in the KFS examples, and those examples are not case-specific to this loan.
The floating-rate reset circular is withdrawn and no longer in force on the as-of date, so it does not supply an in-force rule for this question.
